items.title: Pay outstanding debt collection claim
items.quote: Zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens am Mittwoch, 02.12.2026 auf unser Treuhandkonto.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar due date for payment: Wednesday, 02.12.2026. This is a fixed date set by the collection agency, not a statutory period requiring counting from delivery, so no §187/§188 BGB calculation is needed. Checked against the calendar: 2026-12-02 does fall on a Wednesday as stated, and it is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NW, so no shift under §193 BGB is required.

warnings: This is a demand from a private debt-collection agency (Inkassobüro), not from a court or authority, and carries no formal Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung (right-of-appeal notice); if the person disputes owing the money for August/September 2026 internet service, they should contact Beispielnetz Kabel GmbH and/or the collection agency in writing with reasons before paying, rather than treat the 02.12.2026 date as a legally enforced deadline.

Before paying, verify that the underlying invoices for August and September 2026 and the referenced reminder of 12.10.2026 actually exist and are correct, and double-check the IBAN/account details given (DE20 3705 0198 0005 5664 00) independently rather than trusting this letter alone, since debt-collection letters are a common vector for fraud.
